blocks.text: Focus Global, Inc. (FGI) recently marked a significant milestone, celebrating 35 years as a leading force in Consumer Goods and Home Furnishings in the country. The occasion, held at Marquis Events Place, was more than a recognition of over three decades of growth; it was a tribute to people—both internally and globally—who have contributed to its success. Flying in from various corners of the globe were foreign suppliers/ partners, demonstrating the deep-rooted relationships FGI has built. The event which drew some 300 guests, was attended by company employees who were treated to surprise performances by Jose Mari Chan and Erik Santos. […]...
